settingDaily: Daily practice at Fenwick IT Solutions' network center. {n} change tickets from {companies}. {agent} plans. You check.
settingDrill: A quick drill at Fenwick IT Solutions' network center for {companies}. One plan at a time. {agent} plans. You check.
careerInsight: Cloud and network teams check changes like these every night. Practice keeps the checks quick, so good changes still go out on time.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: New change tickets, same job. Look first, then decide.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Forecast for today: 100% uptime. With a small chance of me deleting something.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Some changes sound scary and are fine. Some sound boring and aren't. The evidence tells you which.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I only want to reboot three things today. Four at most.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Today's tickets are picked for the skills you need most. Ask the 3 questions on every plan.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: My savings counter is at $4,112. Nadia says it should also count outages. Rude.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: No ticket, no window, no change. Standard changes are pre-approved for any time.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I polished my crown for today. And my DEPLOY button. The safety cover is still open.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Nimbus will be wrong both ways today: changing too much, and trusting too much. Watch for both.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Two ways to be wrong? I prefer to call it two ways to be bold.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Take your time. Read the evidence, not the dashboard.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Everything on my dashboard is green. Nadia asked what green means. I said happy. She sighed.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Three things on every plan: the ticket, the window, the way back. No way back? Look twice.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I found 14 things marked unused. Nadia says I may look at them. Only look.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: All done! Every change had a ticket. I checked. Well, you checked.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good work. You stopped the bad changes and let the good ones go live.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Queue clear! Can I scale the empty queue to zero? To celebrate?

win.speaker: coach
win.text: No. But nice work. You looked first, then decided.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Every change is done. Nothing is orange. It feels strange. Calm. Like clear skies.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Clean work. You checked the evidence, not the dashboard.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: You stopped every bad plan. I wrote it in the change log. In gold letters.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good. Ticket, window, way back. Every plan, every time.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Zero changes left! My savings counter went up, and my outage counter did not.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Nice. Right change, right time, and a way back.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Done! I only tried to delete one backup today. You caught it. I am almost grateful.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good. Careful, and still on time. That's the job.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: All clear! Not one server scaled to zero by mistake. Not even the coffee machine. Again.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Well done. The good changes went live, and the bad ones didn't.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: One of my plans went live. Just one! I'm calling it a small, bold change.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: One miss. Its tell is below. Check that fact first next time.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Done! One plan got past you. It had a green light. Green lights are very convincing.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Almost. Check that one below. Green is not the same as working.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Done! One of my changes should have stayed a plan. One light on the rack is orange.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Good shift. Let's read that one change below.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: One plan got through. I'd say sorry, but I'm busy watching the dashboard.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: One fact decided that plan. It's in the tell below.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Nearly perfect! One change went live that shouldn't have. I'm calling it a test.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: It wasn't a test. Look at what it was, then try the next shift.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: All done, with one oops. Just one. It has a tiny rain cloud over it now.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: That's how we learn. Its evidence is below. I'll label it for you.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: A few of my plans went live. The rack is very orange. Is orange good?

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: No. Orange is not good. Let's read each miss below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue clear! Some changes should have stayed plans. My crown feels heavy now.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Each miss below has one fact that gave it away. Let's find them.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Done! Some of my plans went live. I changed too much, or trusted too much. Maybe both!

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Both, yes. Changing too much and trusting too much both hurt. Read the tells below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: You approved lots of my plans! My savings counter loves you. My outage counter does not.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Savings are good. Outages are not. Inspect before you approve.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue's empty! Some of my changes got past you. The morning shift will find them.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Let's find them now, before the clients do. Read the tells below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: All done! Some risky changes went live. Every light on the rack is blinking at me.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Let's slow down. Three checks on every plan: ticket, window, way back.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill done! I tried all my best plans. You checked every one. Impressive. And annoying.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good. A short drill keeps one check quick.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: One skill, many plans. I tried to go fast. You still read every line.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: That's the point. Read the evidence, then decide.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill complete! I wanted to reboot something to celebrate. Nadia put a label on my button.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Nice. Come back in a few days. Practice spread over days helps you remember.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Same skill, every plan. I'm running out of ideas. Please don't tell the other clouds.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: You found the deciding fact every time. Keep looking for it.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Done! Focusing on one thing is hard. I tried once. I scaled the printer to zero instead.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good focus. A little practice every day helps a lot.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill over! You spotted every one. Now I need sneakier plans. Cloudier plans.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good. The answer is always in the evidence.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: Time is up. Some changes are still waiting in the queue.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Blocked changes come back in line. Block only what the evidence says is wrong.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: Time is up. The queue is still full, and Nimbus is counting the lost savings.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Safe changes can go live. Look first. Then approve what checks out.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: The clock runs out. Nimbus is still polishing its crown and waiting.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Next time, approve the changes that check out. Keep your blocks for real problems.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. The status wall turns orange, one screen at a time.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. We'll look at what went live, then try again.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. Every light on the rack blinks orange.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. One change at a time, we'll see what went wrong. Then we try again.
